fine_lines.title: only vs just
fine_lines.explanation_ar: كثيرًا ما تتبادلان المعنى (فقط). just تضيف معنى بالضبط أو ليس كثيرًا. only تعني محدودًا بـ، ويمكن أن تكون صفة (the only, an only child) أو أداة ربط بمعنى إلا أن.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Often interchangeable. Just adds "exactly / not much". Only means "limited to", and it can also be an adjective (an only child) or a conjunction meaning "except that".

examples.sentence: She is the only student who finished.

fine_lines.title: barely vs merely
fine_lines.explanation_ar: barely تعني بالكاد، أي كاد ألّا يحدث. merely تعني مجرّد، أي لا أكثر من ذلك.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Barely = almost not; it nearly didn't happen. Merely = just, nothing more.

expressions.meaning_en: It is very easy to reach.
expressions.example: The website is just a click away.

expressions.meaning_en: used to wish something were different
expressions.example: If only I had more time!
My grandmother is one of a kind.

expressions.meaning_en: arrive just in time, almost late
expressions.example: The bus was slow, and I barely made it on time.

grammar.title: Different jobs of "only"
grammar.explanation_ar: only قد تكون: ظرفًا بمعنى فقط (There are only ten.)، أو صفة بمعنى الوحيد (an only child)، أو أداة ربط بمعنى إلا أن (like my old car, only bigger).
grammar.explanation_en: Only can be an adverb = limited to (There are only ten.), an adjective = the one (an only child), or a conjunction = except that (like my old car, only bigger).
examples: She is the only doctor in the village.
This flat is like our old one, only bigger.

grammar.title: "barely" has a negative meaning
grammar.explanation_ar: barely لها معنى النفي، فلا نستخدم معها not. نقول I can barely see وليس I can't barely see.
grammar.explanation_en: Barely already has a negative meaning, so don't use "not" with it. Say "I can barely see", not "I can't barely see".
examples: We had barely arrived when it started to rain.
